question: At 32 Eevee samples and dither 0, do Fast GI and/or TAA temporal reprojection determine complete-sequence decoded-pixel reproducibility?

design.type: 2x2 full factorial with two clean complete-sequence replicates per cell

decisionRule.FAST_GI_CAUSAL_SUPPORT: Both Fast-GI-off cells are exact and both Fast-GI-on cells are non-exact, independent of reprojection, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.REPROJECTION_CAUSAL_SUPPORT: Both reprojection-off cells are exact and both reprojection-on cells are non-exact, independent of Fast GI, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.JOINT_DISABLE_SUPPORT: Only the Fast-GI-off/reprojection-off cell is exact while the other three are non-exact, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.EITHER_DISABLE_SUPPORT: The on/on baseline is non-exact and all three cells that disable at least one factor are exact, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.NO_SUFFICIENT_INTERVENTION: All four cells are non-exact with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.BASELINE_UNSTABLE_OR_MIXED: The fresh on/on baseline is exact or the exactness pattern matches none of the frozen causal forms, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any identity, intervention, invariant, sequence/comparison binding or attack gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: observed Fast GI differs from cell
observed TAA reprojection differs from cell
comparison artifact not bound to both sequence hashes
explicitNonClaims: An exact disabled cell would not prove a specific Blender source-level race or random-number mechanism.
Disabling Fast GI or temporal reprojection may change lighting, noise, ghosting and artistic quality and is not automatically a production recommendation.
Two runs per cell can falsify exact determinism but cannot estimate mismatch probability.
No perceptual tolerance is selected and near-equality remains non-exact.
The result applies only to this Blender 5.2 Eevee PNG8 same-machine profile, not Cycles EXR masters or other devices.
A mixed pattern is not simplified after execution into the nearest favorable causal story.
